start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Welcome, I guess. What personal failing are we frosting today?

start.speaker: Customer
start.text: I want my sister’s husband to fall in love with me.

start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Uh-huh. I’ll throw in a conscience. Yours appears to be missing.

good_result.speaker: Fairy
good_result.text: Would you like a bag for the cake? And another for your shame?

bad_result.speaker: Fairy
bad_result.text: Wrong cake. Though trying someone else’s seems to be your thing.

hint.speaker: Fairy
hint.text: Something to peel away his attachment, something to help a new one bloom.
